english.选择或输入电视剧根目录: Choose or enter a TV root
english.恢复默认字段、顺序与宽度: Restore Default Columns, Order, and Widths
english.当前组合条件没有匹配的 NFO: No NFOs match the current filters.
english.请先选择一个 NFO，或勾选需要批量处理的 NFO: Select an NFO or select NFOs for batch processing first.
english.手动指定状态只影响本 NFO 当前版本：内容变化后自动失效；重新生成标签也会覆盖: A manual status applies only to this NFO revision. It expires when the content changes and is replaced when tags are regenerated.
english.当前 NFO 没有可编辑的 Technical Specs。: This NFO has no editable Technical Specs.
english.编辑规格后，Tag 状态会变为“待同步”；不会自动刷新 IMDb，也不会自动重建: After editing Specs, Tag status changes to Out of Sync. IMDb will not refresh and tags will not rebuild automatically. Choose AI or Rules below to regenerate them.
english.点徽章可修改所有权（外部/TMM · AI 生成 · 规则生成 · Manual: Select a badge to change ownership (External/TMM · AI Generated · Rules Generated · Manual), then confirm to write the NFO.
english.当前 NFO 没有 AI 生成的标签: This NFO has no AI-generated tags.
english.生成标签 · 蓝灰：NFO 现有标签: generated tags · Blue-gray: existing NFO tags
english.NFO 缺少 IMDb ID: The NFO is missing an IMDb ID.
english.尚未准备 IMDb Technical Specs: IMDb Technical Specs are not ready.
english.技术标签尚未与当前规格同步: Technical tags are out of sync with the current Specs.
english.manifest 中的生成标签在根节点缺失: A generated tag in the manifest is missing from the root nodes.
english.AI 结果等待人工复核: The AI result requires manual review.
english.发现同值重复标签；为安全起见不会自动删除: Duplicate tags with the same value were found and will not be removed automatically.
english.NFO manifest 与本地 ownership 镜像不一致: The NFO manifest does not match the local ownership mirror.
english.NFO 类型与所选资料库分类不一致；已停止生成操作: The NFO type does not match the selected library category; generation was stopped.
english.AI 提示词/模型已更新；建议重新生成（状态保持 AI 完成）: The AI prompt or model changed. Regeneration is recommended; status remains AI complete.
english.请将这些目录重新添加到电影或电视剧分类后保存。: Add these folders to Movies or TV Shows, then save.
english.部分缓存正在使用: Some Cache Files Are in Use
english.没有可用的 TMM 候选，请手动选择目录。: No TMM suggestions are available. Choose folders manually.
english.请求超时（90 秒），请检查资料库是否在线: Request timed out after 90 seconds. Check whether the library is online.
english.连接本地服务失败，请重试: Could not connect to the local service. Try again.
english.界面布局保存失败: Failed to save the interface layout
english.界面布局暂未保存，下次调整时会重试: The interface layout was not saved and will be retried after the next adjustment.
english.当前是静态预览；请启动 App 后刷新媒体库: This is a static preview. Launch the app before refreshing the library.
english.任务已提交，但服务未返回任务编号: The task was submitted, but the service did not return a task ID.
english.等待任务完成超时；请在任务中心查看实际状态: Timed out while waiting for the task. Check its actual status in Task Center.
english.这是静态界面预览。启动 IMDb Tech Manager App 后会连接本地: This is a static interface preview. Launch IMDb Tech Manager to connect to the local service and load NFOs.
english.资料库已确认；现在可以手动启动后台模式: Libraries confirmed. You can now enable background mode manually.
english.至少确认一个电影或电视剧目录: Confirm at least one movie or TV folder.
english.IMDb 抓取缓存上限必须是 64 到 65536 之间的整数 MB: The IMDb fetch-cache limit must be an integer from 64 to 65536 MB.
english.缓存上限已保存，正在按新上限整理: Cache limit saved. Maintenance is running with the new limit.
english.输入新的 Manual Tech Tag: Enter a new Manual Tech Tag
english.删除这条规格值？标签不会自动重建。: Delete this Spec value? Tags will not rebuild automatically.
english.恢复为保存的 IMDb 原始抓取值？当前人工规格将被替换，标签只会标记为待同步。: Restore the saved IMDb values? Current manual Specs will be replaced and tags will only be marked Out of Sync.
english.确定清空 IMDb 抓取缓存？\n\n只会删除 IMDb 原始页面和解析结果，不:
Clear the IMDb fetch cache?

Only raw IMDb pages and parsed results will be deleted. NFOs, AI cache, index, browser sessions, logs, and task records are preserved.
english.确定退出？后台 Agent 与常驻引擎将一并停止。: Quit? The background Agent and resident engine will also stop.
english.更新信息已失效，请重新检查一次: The update information has expired. Check once more.
english.新版已完成签名验证，应用即将退出并自动替换当前 IMDb Tech Manage: The new version passed signature verification. The app will quit and replace the current IMDb Tech Manager.app.
english.已安全退出，可以关闭此窗口。: Quit safely. You can close this window.
